[[Pastoria Gym]] }} '''Crafty Carnivine''' (Japanese: '''VS マスキッパ''' ''VS Carnivine''), titled '''VS Carnivine''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 365th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 28th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Crasher Wake and Pastoria City''' (Japanese: '''マキシとノモセシティ''' ''Maxi and Nomose City'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Crasher Wake and Pastoria''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} At the [[Great Marsh]], the {{p|Carnivine}} behind {{adv|Lax}} and [[Chatler]] suddenly charges, grabbing the two Pokémon and throwing them into its mouth. {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Pearl}} are initially horrified, but realize that Lax is fighting against Carnivine from inside its mouth. Lax manages to free itself and Chatler, to the boys' relief. Their celebration is cut short when they realize that {{adv|Platinum}} has disappeared underneath the mud. By flailing in fear, Diamond and Pearl escape from the deep mud. After running to dry land, Pearl sends out [[Chimler]] to rescue Platinum. Right as Platinum is unable to continue holding her breath, Chimler swoops in to catch her and bring her to the surface. All together once again, the three leave the Great Marsh and arrive in [[Pastoria City]], still dressed in their overalls. Everyone is weary, and Platinum remains entirely coated in mud. Since they were unable to catch a single {{type|Grass}} Pokémon in the [[Safari Zone|Safari Game]], Diamond offers to lend [[Tru]] to Platinum for her [[Gym]] battle. As they walk through Pastoria City, Platinum remarks how well-maintained everything is. A woman overhears her, and tells her that it is because [[Crasher Wake]] uses his [[prize money|earnings]] from his battles to support the city. Sensing that Platinum would like to wash the mud off of herself, Diamond and Pearl try to get her to visit an inn. To their surprise, Platinum declines. Instead, she heads straight for the [[Pastoria Gym]]. At the Gym, Platinum makes it past the other {{pkmn|Trainer}}s and comes face-to-face with Crasher Wake. He sends out a {{p|Floatzel}} as she sends out her {{p|Empoleon}}. Before the battle can begin, Crasher Wake makes an adjustment to the rules that allows him and Platinum to make use of all waterways in the Gym. The battle starts, and Floatzel and Empoleon exchange blows before taking their battle into the pool. Reading their [[Pokédex]]es, Diamond and Pearl learn that both Empoleon and Floatzel are excellent swimmers. They realize that the match will come down to the fastest Pokémon. ==Major events== * {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} fail to catch anything in the [[Great Marsh]]. * Platinum begins her battle against [[Crasher Wake]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Crasher Wake]] * {{tc|Sailor}} * Gym Statue * [[Pastoria City]] citizens ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Torterra}} ([[Tru]]/{{tt|Wig|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Chatot}} ([[Chatler]]/{{tt|Chahiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Infernape}} ([[Chimler]]/{{tt|Chimhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Ponyta}} ({{OP|Platinum|Ponyta}}) * {{p|Empoleon}} ({{OP|Platinum|Empoleon}}) * {{p|Gyarados}} ([[Crasher Wake]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Floatzel}} ([[Crasher Wake]]'s) * {{p|Quagsire}} ([[Crasher Wake]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Wooper}} (Old lady's) * {{p|Azurill}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Bibarel}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Kricketot}} (Trainer's; ×2) * {{p|Kricketune}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Tentacruel}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Magikarp}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Carnivine}} * {{p|Murkrow}} (×3) * {{p|Wingull}} ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 尖牙籠|VS Carnivine}} (Taiwan)
